message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function to pull the official holiday calendar from an external source, but I can give you a quick rundown of the Canadian public holidays that typically create long weekends in 2023. If you need the exact dates for each province or territory (since some holidays vary regionally), let me know and I can point you toward the appropriate government resources.

**Federal (nationwide) holidays that usually form long weekends in 2023**

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Typical Long‑Weekend Effect |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | New Year’s Eve (Dec 31) + New Year’s Day → 3‑day weekend |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Good Friday + Easter Monday (Apr 10) → 4‑day weekend (if you count both sides) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (May 20–22) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Observed on Jul 3 (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Jul 1–3) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Sep 2–4) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Oct 7–9) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Friday) | 3‑day weekend (Nov 9–11) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Dec 23–25) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | 3‑day weekend (Dec 24–26) |

**Regional holidays that also create long weekends**

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Effect |
|--------------------|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| Ontario | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Feb 18–20) |
| British Columbia | Family Day | Mar 20 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Mar 18–20) |
| Alberta | Family Day | Mar 20 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Mar 18–20) |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day | Mar 20 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Mar 18–20) |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Mar 20 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Mar 18–20) |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Jun 22–24) |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | 3‑day weekend (Mar 15–17) |
| Nunavut | Nunavut Day | Jun 21 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Jun 19–21) |
| Northwest Territories | NWT Day | Jun 21 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Jun 19–21) |
| Yukon | Yukon Day | Aug 7 (Monday) | 3‑day weekend (Aug 5–7) |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |

If you need the full, official list—including provincial/territorial variations and any special observances—here are the primary sources you can consult:

* **Government of Canada – Public Holidays**: https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-service.html
* **Provincial/Territorial Government Websites**: Each province/territory publishes its own holiday calendar (e.g., Ontario’s Ministry of Finance, BC’s Employment Standards Branch, etc.).

Let me know if you’d like me to compile a more detailed table with all regional holidays or if you’d prefer a link to a downloadable CSV/Excel file that you can import into your app.
